Subject: Need help with a cheque bounce case

Hello, my name is Gaurav Malhotra. I am a 41-year-old nurse living in Warangal. Crescent Enterprises gave me a cheque for 3.2 lakh rupees to repay a loan, but the drawer stopped the cheque with a stop-payment instruction. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on 07997513921 or email gaurav.malhotra@example.com.
